name: Joram
bio: Joram was the son of Toi, king of Hamath, sent by his father to greet David and congratulate him after his victory over Hadadezer of Zobah, Hamath's old rival. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, gold, and bronze, which David dedicated to the LORD along with the rest of the plunder from the nations he had subdued (2 Samuel 8:9-11).
